West Bengal Assembly Tables OBC Amendment Bills for Reservation Policy Overhaul

The West Bengal Assembly has tabled twin bills to amend the reservation policy, which could potentially revamp the system. The move comes amid ongoing debates over the OBC (Other Backward Classes) quota in the state. The government plans to introduce a Uniform Civil Code Bill in the Assembly on Monday, which has sparked concerns among some groups. The assembly's decision is part of efforts to address long-standing issues related to reservation policy and social welfare.
